exposure: Predisposition for diabetes (GDM or diabetes after pregnancy)
cohort: Women in a population-based cohort who also were registered in the Swedish Medical Birth Registry (n = 4738)
finding: Pregnant women with a predisposition for diabetes had a higher frequency of LGA, macrosomia and caesarean section.
mod_finding: Pregnancies complicated by both maternal predisposition for diabetes and BMI ≥ 25 kg/m2 were associated with a higher frequency of caesarean section (24.0% vs. 14.9%, p = 0.031) compared to pregnancies in women who were only overweight.
